input.label: CONTRADICTED
input.reasoning_summary:
After investigating potential challenges to the initial verdict, the CONTRADICTED label remains correct. 

H1 (alternative operating margin definitions): The retrieved evidence discusses Core EPS and adjusted free cash flow productivity, but provides no alternative definition or adjusted measure of operating margin that would show expansion above 24%. No relevant evidence supports this challenge.

H2 (segment-specific margins): While the evidence identifies P&G's five reportable segments, it provides no segment-level operating margin data for fiscal 2026. The claim refers to "P&G" generally, which reasonably means consolidated results. No relevant evidence supports this challenge.

H3 (interim period data): The evidence actually refutes this challenge. Quarterly data shows operating margins of 24.2% (Q2 ended Dec 31, 2025), 24.0% (nine months ended Mar 31, 2026), and 21.5% (Q3 ended Mar 31, 2026) - all representing decreases versus prior year periods. While Q2 showed 24.2% (slightly above 24%), this was still a 200 basis point decrease from the prior year, contradicting the "margin expansion" claim.

The original evidence E6 from the FY2026 10-K definitively shows operating margin was 22.7% (below 24%) and decreased 160 basis points from 24.3% in FY2025 (margin contraction, not expansion). Both material parts of the claim are contradicted.
